haystack.title: Research consultant
haystack.intro: Clients come with a question. My job is to get them a usable answer, from the first meeting to the final presentation. The method follows from the question.

steps.name: Methodology
steps.what: pick the design that answers it

steps.name: Screener & questionnaire
steps.what: the right people, the right questions

steps.name: Fieldwork
steps.what: follow up until the sample is in

steps.name: Insights
steps.what: what the client should decide, and why

haystack.panelText: Our job: make our internal processes more efficient and keep up with the latest innovations in research. We test new techniques on live client projects and keep what works. Predictive models show which drivers actually move purchase intent, so segmentation and targeting rest on more than averages. Synthetic data lets us explore small or hard-to-reach groups before fieldwork budget goes there. Dashboards coded in R and Displayr update themselves when a new wave comes in, instead of being rebuilt by hand.
